decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program builds on the firm's existing domestic manufacturing and logistics know-how, but it overlaps with the broader express line D, so it may be consolidated.

The seventy-two-hour delivery program uses the firm's spare-parts and production logistics capabilities, though its narrow scope and overlap with D make it a candidate for being folded into the main line.

The fire-resistant exterior door extends the established Teckentrup 62 modular fire-door system and already holds European approval, so it builds directly on deep core knowledge and certification expertise.
The express delivery line, with several models and its own page, draws on the firm's integrated manufacturing and provides clear early market feedback it can learn from.
The online ordering platform supports trade partners and the one-stop service strategy, and its usage data is easy to interpret and use for improving the platform.
The fire and smoke protection door is a core competence of the firm, backed by its engineering, certification and safety-compliance systems.
